'''Arn Stonelaw''' was a [[Corellian chorba-root|chorba]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. He was married to [[Emmi Stonelaw|Emmi]], and had two sons, [[Kristoff Stonelaw|Kristoff]] and [[Yuri Stonelaw|Yuri]]. Arn and Emmi also agreed to foster [[Mair Koda]], the daughter of a family friend, after her mother ran off with a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], leaving her father unable to deal with raising his daughter and earning a living as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]].<ref name="TD" />
